transport.abi: existing generic procedure ABI >=2.20; capability discovered by method_id, not ABI alone
transport.X: query n x p; finite doubles, zero-filled masked cells
transport.X_target: optional reference 1 x p for spectral_reference_qc supplied mode; training n_ref x p for local_density novelty mode

row_signal.<signal>_values: finite double matrix m x 1, omitted when m=0
row_signal.<signal>_rows: integer vector m of original query row indices, omitted when m=0
row_signal.<signal>_status: integer vector n with one status code per query row

aggregate.<signal>_median: scalar, absent when no eligible observations
aggregate.<signal>_p95: scalar, absent when no eligible observations

output_convention.quantiles: Hyndman-Fan type7: linear interpolation at (m-1)*q, no nonfinite observations
output_convention.missing_values: absence plus explicit status; never NaN, infinity, numeric placeholder or missing-to-zero conversion

axis_values.meaning: actual axis values in declared unit; no implicit wavelength assumption

diagnostics.spectral_reference_qc.reference: dataset_mean computed natively per feature over valid query cells; supplied uses X_target and never fits to query

extra_outputs.reference: finite reference values matrix 1 x p with zero only at explicitly invalid coordinates
extra_outputs.reference_counts: integer vector p; dataset mean eligible observation counts, supplied validity indicators

formulae.rms: sqrt(mean((x-reference)^2)) on common valid coordinates, needs >=1
formulae.sam: acos(clamp(dot(x,r)/(norm(x)*norm(r)),-1,1)) radians, needs >=2 common and nonzero norms
formulae.affine: OLS x=offset+gain*reference on common coordinates, needs >=2 common and positive centered reference sum of squares
formulae.affine_residual_rms: sqrt(mean((x-offset-gain*reference)^2)), denominator common count, not count-2

diagnostics.spectral_reference_qc.legacy_equivalence: matches Datasets reference_similarity on complete finite matrices; masked protocol excludes cells and never performs legacy column imputation

formulae.index: first differences x[j+1]-x[j]; second differences x[j+2]-2*x[j+1]+x[j]
formulae.physical: first difference divided by signed axis gap; second derivative 2*(slope[j+1]-slope[j])/(axis[j+2]-axis[j]); axis strictly monotonic ascending or descending
formulae.events: per row and derivative order: abs(d-median(d)) > threshold*scale; scale=1.4826*MAD; when MAD=0 use sample std(ddof1); all-constant yields computed zero; fewer than3 eligible differences unavailable
formulae.mask: only adjacent valid pairs/triples; never bridge masked holes
formulae.fraction: events divided by eligible adjacent pairs/triples with valid statistic; counts and denominators native
formulae.declared_clip: valid x<=lower+tolerance or x>=upper-tolerance, at least one bound required; no bound means status5; two bounds require lower<upper

extra_outputs.observed_extrema_occupancy_fraction: native scalar descriptive proxy across all valid cells
extra_outputs.global_jump_count: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_jump_fraction: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_jump_eligible: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_spike_count: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_spike_fraction: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_spike_eligible: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_declared_clip_count: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_declared_clip_fraction: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic
extra_outputs.global_declared_clip_eligible: native scalar plus status integer vector length1; pooled only rows with computed statistic

diagnostics.spectral_events_qc.extrema_proxy: lo/hi observed valid dataset extrema, epsilon=max(1e-12,max(abs(lo),abs(hi))*1e-8); occupancy=within epsilon of lo or hi; NOT physical clipping
diagnostics.spectral_events_qc.legacy_equivalence: index mode equals Datasets artefact differences on complete matrices with sufficient features; valid denominator differs explicitly when masks/missing cells occur

formulae.noise_sigma: median(abs(diff2 - median(diff2)))*1.4826/sqrt(6), per row on eligible valid triples
formulae.signal_noise_ratio: per row signal_mean_abs/noise_sigma only when both positive
formulae.global_signal_mean_abs: mean(abs(X)) over all valid dataset cells
formulae.bandwise_min: minimum finite abs(mean(valid X[:,j]))/(MAD(valid diff2[:,j-1])*1.4826/sqrt(6)) over interior features j with positive scale
formulae.bandwise_median: type-7 median of the same finite bandwise ratios
formulae.worst_band_index: zero-based interior feature index attaining bandwise_min; first index wins ties

extra_outputs.global_noise_sigma: native finite scalar plus global_noise_sigma_status integer vector length1
extra_outputs.global_signal_mean_abs: native finite scalar plus global_signal_mean_abs_status integer vector length1
extra_outputs.global_signal_noise_ratio: native finite scalar plus global_signal_noise_ratio_status integer vector length1
extra_outputs.global_signal_noise_db: native finite scalar plus global_signal_noise_db_status integer vector length1
extra_outputs.bandwise_min: native finite scalar plus bandwise_min_status integer vector length1; status4 when undefined
extra_outputs.bandwise_median: native finite scalar plus bandwise_median_status integer vector length1; status4 when undefined
extra_outputs.worst_band_index: native finite scalar plus worst_band_index_status integer vector length1; status4 when undefined

diagnostics.spectral_noise_proxy.interpretation: descriptive index-space high frequency proxy; not instrumental SNR, not physical-axis derivative, not existing SG band_noise
diagnostics.spectral_noise_proxy.legacy_equivalence: matches Datasets spectral_noise global noise_rms/snr/snr_db and bandwise ratios within floating-point tolerance on identical populations and masks; Dataset maps nonfinite input cells to zero-fill plus an explicit exclusion mask, without imputation

formulae.kernel: reuse native vendored LOF; expose native training scores from fitted density, not novelty scoring on training rows
formulae.training: reference=X; exclude each row itself from kNN; effective k=min(requested,n_ref-1)
formulae.novelty: reference=X_target; query X never fitted; effective k=min(requested,n_ref-1), the fitted training neighborhood
formulae.ties: stable fixed-k neighbour ordering, not all-distance-tie expansion
formulae.degenerate_density: nonfinite/undefined density yields status4, no arbitrary finite replacement

diagnostics.local_density.mask_policy: all valid finite rectangular data required; no silent imputation or distance over inconsistent coordinate subsets
diagnostics.local_density.interpretation: outlier density ratio, not calibrated anomaly probability or possible physical cause

inputs.X_target: complete finite reference n_ref*p, n_ref>=2; only fitting population

outputs.eigenvalues: 1*k ddof1 eigenvalues from native train scores
outputs.exact_full_moments_status: integer vector[6], not requested; never replaced by truncated moments

diagnostics.pca_reference_qc.normalization: column-centering on train only; no automatic scaling or imputation; query never changes fit
diagnostics.pca_reference_qc.q: squared residual norm after reconstructing resolved retained components only
diagnostics.pca_reference_qc.t2: sum(score^2/eigenvalue) for resolved retained components, status3 when none
diagnostics.pca_reference_qc.budgets: Existing preflight_pca_budget whole-computation ceiling, plus query/output passes and buffers: 2.4billion long-double multiply-add equivalents including eigensolver ceiling,1GiB simultaneous buffers,50million cells, checked before allocations.
diagnostics.pca_reference_qc.solver_reuse: existing FlexiblePCA fitted representation and existing exact dual Gram/Jacobi kernels; no alternative PCA implementation; existing FlexiblePCA randomized default remains unchanged
